rationale: Lydia bridges developer experience and AI tooling at Anthropic's Claude Code team, while Jiale builds the ML infrastructure and distributed systems that power models like Claude at Meta—they're on complementary sides of the AI developer tools stack. Lydia's expertise in making complex technical concepts accessible to developers and her conviction that agentic coding tools fundamentally change software engineering could inform how Jiale thinks about infrastructure abstractions for AI researchers and engineers.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Jiale Zhi — you're both in San Francisco working on opposite ends of the AI/ML stack (Claude tooling vs. deep learning infrastructure), and your perspectives on making complex systems accessible to developers could spark an interesting conversation.
